minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  February 15, 2022

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Robin Carder at 6:30 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Robin Carder, Chair – Council Member
  Rick Crosby, Vice Chair – Council Member
  Greg Palatto - BUSD
  Denise Fisher – Resident
  Don Kendrick - Resident

  Chris Dransfeldt, LVPD
  Hollie Savage, LVPD
  Janessa Gonzalez, LVPD
  Joy Lindsay, BUSD
  Edward McMillon, BUSD
  Grant Dineley, BUSD
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne
  Alfie Sanchez, Majestic Cycling/Kiwanis International
  Ron Serven, Resident
  Charleen Mejia, Resident

3. Intro. Of New Executive Dir.  Chair Robin Carder introduced Don Kendrick as the
  newest Executive Board Member. Mr. Kendrick
  shared a few thoughts on YFAC and his associated
  passion for the group noting his considerable
  experience participating over numerous years in
  many capacities.

4. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the November 16, 2021, meeting were
  approved with an amendment correcting a numbering
  error.

5. School Resource Officer  SRO Janessa Gonzalez provided information with
  students transitioning through impacts of COVID.
  Janessa also shared information on the recent mask
  protests as well as on recent enforcement efforts
  related to flavored tobacco products. The group
  discussed menthol and staff was directed to clarify its
  enforcement or not.

6. BUSD Update  Report was postponed to the next meeting.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes February 15, 2022, page 2

7. BHS Update  Bonita High School Vice-Principal Edward McMillon
  shared information on continuing efforts regarding
  vaping and addressing impacts from COVID on
  students. Edward also shared information about
  activities that have and will be taking place at the
  school and highlighted the success of girls soccer and
  girls water polo.

8. Billie Eilish Article  Chair Robin Carder discussed a recent article that was
  attached to the agenda regarding artist Billie Eilish and
  her exposure to pornography and its associated
  impacts. The group engaged in a significant
  conversation discussing issues with exposure to social
  media and other areas that can be harmful to youth.
  Charlene Mejia noted the potential to work with PTA
  groups in order to get helpful information to families.
  Ron Serven noted the possibility to engage school
  service clubs and leadership groups as a path to
  educate students effectively. Staff was directed to
  take the lead on exploring these and other effective
  opportunities over the next several months and
  bringing back possible programs for the next school
  year.

9. Community Well Being Grant JR Ranells with the City of La Verne presented
  information regarding the Community Well Being Grant
  offered by Tri-City Mental Health. Staff will work with
  YFAC participants to generate possible ideas for a
  YFAC specific application and bring back for direction
  at the March meeting.

10. Public Comment  Chair Carder mentioned issues related to bullying, Ron
  Serven noted relationship with the La Verne/San
  Dimas Education Foundation and areas of their efforts,
  and Don Kendrick shared a desire related to youth
  representation from Ramona Middle School.

11. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for March
  22, 2022.

12. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:50 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Assistant to the City Manager
